complete_properties.c_0_core_nature: The dynamic, ongoing temporal process through which meanings sediment - the gerund "constituting" rather than the noun "constitution." This is where living insight gradually hardens into habitual understanding, where the fresh becomes familiar, where the explicit becomes implicit. Not a single moment but the stretched-out process of accumulation, the slow descent from conscious attention into pre-conscious background. Husserl's Sedimentierung (sedimentation) as active process, Heidegger's temporality as ecstatic structure, the documents' recognition that "sediment is not behind us chronologically but beneath us structurally."
complete_properties.c_0_essence: Enacts the temporal thickness of consciousness - retention (just-past held in awareness), primal impression (now-point), protention (about-to-be anticipated). But operates at a deeper level: how the very structures of meaning-giving themselves sediment over time, becoming invisible background that shapes future meaning-constitution without being explicitly recognized. This is operative history (Wirkungsgeschichte) - tradition working through us even when we don't recognize it, sedimented wisdom and sedimented prejudice equally.
complete_properties.c_0_operational_essence: Enacts the temporal thickness of consciousness - retention (just-past held in awareness), primal impression (now-point), protention (about-to-be anticipated). But operates at a deeper level: how the very structures of meaning-giving themselves sediment over time, becoming invisible background that shapes future meaning-constitution without being explicitly recognized. This is operative history (Wirkungsgeschichte) - tradition working through us even when we don't recognize it, sedimented wisdom and sedimented prejudice equally.
complete_properties.c_1_description: The dynamic, ongoing temporal process through which meanings sediment - the gerund "constituting" rather than completed "constitution." Where living insight gradually hardens into habitual understanding, where the fresh becomes familiar, where the explicit becomes implicit. Husserl's Sedimentierung as active process, Heidegger's temporality as ecstatic structure. The documents: "sediment is not behind us chronologically but beneath us structurally" - the past as ground rather than bygone.
complete_properties.c_2_heideggerian: Temporality as ecstatic structure - past/present/future as simultaneous dimensions not linear sequence
complete_properties.c_2_heideggerian_geschichte: Heidegger distinguished Historie (historiography, chronicle of events) from Geschichte (historicity, the happening of history). Constituting is pure Geschichte - the way the past doesn't just influence us but constitutes us, makes us what we are. We don't have a past; we ARE our past in the mode of having-been. The documents echo this: "The past is not behind us but beneath us" (Merleau-Ponty) - structuring the present as its ground.
complete_properties.c_4_crisis_and_reactivation: Constituting normally operates invisibly, but crisis disrupts it: when sedimented meanings no longer work, when tradition no longer makes sense, when accumulated understanding fails to account for new experience. Crisis calls for phenomenological archaeology - excavating through layers of sedimentation to reach constitutional origins for reactivation. This is why Husserl titled his late work "The Crisis" - recognizing that when meaning-systems break down, we must excavate their origins.
complete_properties.c_4_double_movement: Paradoxical double movement: (1) Constituting makes meanings less conscious (sedimentation into background), (2) Yet this backgrounding enables higher-level consciousness (freed attention for new insights). Sedimentation isn't purely negative - it's necessary. We couldn't function if everything required explicit attention. The problem comes when: (a) sedimentation conceals its own origins (forgetting we constituted this), (b) sedimented patterns become rigid (blocking new constitution).
complete_properties.c_4_etymological_flow: In the SENSE→SEDIMENT chain: SENSE (feeling) → SENT (transmitted) → SCENT (trace) → SCIENCE (discriminative cutting) → SENTIMENT (feeling-toward-settling) → SEDIMENT (settled). This coordinate occupies the SCENT position - where what was SENT (transmitted from origin) leaves its SCENT (trace in time). The trace IS the temporal sedimentation process. Etymology itself operates here - how meanings leave traces across centuries.
complete_properties.c_4_husserlian: Sedimentierung as active process creating pre-given horizon that shapes future constitution
complete_properties.c_4_husserlian_passive_synthesis: Husserl's late work explored "passive synthesis" - meaning-constitution happening beneath the level of active attention. This coordinate is where passive synthesis operates temporally: associations forming automatically, expectations building up unconsciously, horizons of meaning establishing themselves without deliberate effort. The paradox: we're active in our passivity, constituting meaning even when we think we're just receiving it.
complete_properties.c_4_karma_as_impurity: Not karma as cosmic law but karma mala as impurity - the forgetting that we are free, experiencing action as binding
complete_properties.c_4_karma_mala_dimension: Karma mala operates through temporal sedimentation - past actions creating determining patterns
complete_properties.c_4_liberation: Reactivation (Reaktivierung) breaks karma mala - seeing sedimented patterns as contingent not necessary
complete_properties.c_4_mala_note: Karma mala (sense of action-bondage) operates through temporal sedimentation
complete_properties.c_4_merleau_ponty: Past sediments into body-memory, pre-objective layer, habitual capacities
complete_properties.c_4_merleau_ponty_institution: Merleau-Ponty's concept of "institution" (not the sedimented result but the sedimenting process): "Sometimes the meaning aimed at cannot be achieved by the body's natural means; it must then build itself an instrument, and it projects thereby around itself a cultural world." Constituting is this projecting-building activity - not completed structures but the structuring activity itself. Love institutions, language institutions, art institutions - patterns that continue, that structure future experience without determining it.
complete_properties.c_4_methodological_challenge: How to study a process we're always already in? We can't step outside temporality to observe it objectively. Phenomenology's answer: reflective analysis that recognizes its own temporal structure. EPII's approach: etymological archaeology that traces sedimentation historically, revealing the process by showing its products at different temporal stages. Both methods acknowledge: we study constituting FROM WITHIN constituting, using temporality to understand temporality.
complete_properties.c_4_operative_history: Past not chronologically behind but structurally beneath - grounds present understanding
complete_properties.c_4_reversibility: Sedimentation can be reactivated (Reaktivierung) - not permanent burial but provisional backgrounding
complete_properties.c_4_samsaric_dimension: The documents reveal: "SAMSARA (flowing-together, unrecognized) = SAMAVESA (divine possession, recognized)." Constituting is this flowing-together (sam-sara) - the continuous flux of experience, the river of becoming. Unrecognized, it feels like bondage (caught in time's stream). Recognized, it's the divine play (lila). Same process, different recognition. Constituting is neutral - it becomes bondage or freedom depending on relationship to it.
complete_properties.c_4_samskara_karma_link: Samskaras are material traces of karma mala - habitual patterns carrying karmic determination forward
complete_properties.c_4_sedimentation_dynamic: Living insight gradually hardens into habitual understanding through temporal accumulation
complete_properties.c_4_sedimentation_dynamics: How meanings sediment: (1) Explicit understanding (thematic consciousness), (2) Repeated engagement (habitual access), (3) Fading from attention (sinking into background), (4) Operating pre-consciously (shaping without being recognized), (5) Forgotten origin (Urstiftung concealed by layers of tradition), (6) Crisis/disruption (calling for phenomenological excavation). This isn't linear progression but complex dynamics - meanings can resurface, be reactivated, sediment again differently.
complete_properties.c_4_structural_past: Sediment is not behind us chronologically but beneath us structurally - operates as ground not bygone
complete_properties.c_4_tattvaic_correspondence: Kala limits, Niyati determines, Parashakti vibrates, Shakti flows, Samskaras accumulate
complete_properties.c_4_three_malas_pattern: The three impurities structure phenomenological experience across #4.4.4.0-1-2
complete_properties.m_4_kashmir_shaivism_alignment: Corresponds to Parashakti - the dynamic vibrational aspect of consciousness, the creative power (shakti) that manifests the static ground (Shiva) into temporal becoming. This is spanda not as single pulse but as ongoing rhythmic vibration - the cosmic heartbeat. The documents emphasize: "Spanda at finite frequency = discrete oscillations, partial satisfactions, mortal meanings." Constituting operates at this finite frequency - meanings arising and subsiding, never quite achieving permanence.
complete_properties.m_4_practical_manifestations: In lived experience: (1) How a skill becomes "second nature" through practice, (2) How cultural assumptions sink into invisibility, (3) How repeated experiences create expectations, (4) How language shapes thought without our awareness, (5) How personal history becomes the lens through which we see the present. For EPII users: recognizing how word-meanings have shifted over time, how semantic fields have moved, how etymological roots have branched and re-combined.
complete_properties.m_4_temporal_structure: Retention (just-past held) + primal impression (now-point) + protention (about-to-be anticipated)
complete_properties.t_4_temporal_thickness: Consciousness has temporal depth - not knife-edge present but stretched-out now
complete_properties.t_4_whiteheadian_transition: Whitehead's concept of "transition" - the passage from one actual occasion to the next, where the satisfied occasion perishes into objectivity and becomes datum for successor occasions. But transition isn't empty gap between occasions - it's the transmission of achieved pattern, the handing-over of accumulated meaning. Constituting is transition as it operates in meaning-making: each insight achieving satisfaction then perishing into tradition that informs future insights.

Institution in Merleau-Ponty's sense: not just social institutions but the institutED - what has been established through sedimentation and now operates as pre-given framework.
complete_properties.c_0_essence: Operates as the received symbolic order - the langue before parole, the cultural archive before individual utterance, the traditional wisdom before personal insight. This is the "already-there" (Vorhanden) that every individual is thrown into: you don't choose your native language, your cultural symbols, your bodily hexis, your sedimented habits. They choose you - or more accurately, you emerge already-constituted by them. Yet Institution isn't deterministic: it provides possibilities (and constraints) for individual appropriation.
complete_properties.c_0_operational_essence: Operates as the received symbolic order - the langue before parole, the cultural archive before individual utterance, the traditional wisdom before personal insight. complete_properties.c_0_second_nature: Cultural forms so thoroughly sedimented they feel like first nature - "natural" perception, "obvious" categories
complete_properties.c_1_archives_and_texts: Institutions manifest in material forms: (1) Textual traditions (Vedas, Bible, philosophical corpus), (2) Architectural structures (temples, cities, dwellings), (3) Ritual practices (liturgy, ceremony, custom), (4) Artistic canons (painting traditions, musical forms), (5) Scientific paradigms (theoretical frameworks, experimental methods). Dialogue with autonomous psychic contents (not hallucination)
Method for reactivating sedimented symbolic patterns
Similar to phenomenological reduction but toward psyche not essence

Not objects but modes of experiencing - templates not content
Universal patterns inherited collectively, not learned individually
Shadow, Anima/Animus, Self as specific archetypal configurations
Archetypes-as-such never directly accessible, only through images

Transmitted through generations as psychic DNA
Cultural myths, religious symbols, fairy tales as its expressions
Not learned but born with - pre-given symbolic structures
Functions like sedimented Mahamaya at species level
Personal psyche emerges from and within this collective matrix
complete_properties.c_4_crisis_of_institutions: When institutions break down: (1) Tradition no longer makes sense (meaning-crisis), (2) Symbolic systems feel arbitrary (legitimation-crisis), (3) Body habits become pathological (somatization), (4) Language fails to express (linguistic alienation), (5) Cultural forms feel empty (spiritual crisis). complete_properties.c_4_cultural_hermeneutics: Institution is where hermeneutics operates - the interpretation of inherited meanings, the appropriation of tradition, the dialogue between past and present. Gadamer's "effective history" (Wirkungsgeschichte) works at this level: tradition isn't dead past but living force shaping present understanding. Ricoeur's "conflict of interpretations" occurs here: different ways of appropriating the same institutions, revealing their surplus of meaning.
complete_properties.c_4_double_aspect: Institution has paradoxical double character: (1) ENABLING - provides forms through which experience becomes meaningful, symbolic resources for expression, traditional wisdom as resource, (2) CONSTRAINING - limits what can be thought/said/done, sediments into rigid patterns, conceals constitutional origins. Not inherently good or bad but ambiguous - requiring critical appropriation. Phenomenology doesn't reject institutions but interrogates them.
complete_properties.c_4_epii_etymological_work: EPII's etymological archaeology primarily operates on institutions: current word-meanings are institutions (sedimented usage), PIE roots reveal constitutional origins (how meaning was originally instituted), semantic shifts show constituting process (how sedimentation occurred), cross-linguistic cognates demonstrate institutional stability (patterns persisting across cultures/centuries). Etymology excavates language-institutions to reveal their constitutional ground for possible reactivation.

complete_properties.c_4_genetic_dimension: Symbolic body IS genetically encoded - cultural DNA, archetypal templates as literal generative codes
complete_properties.c_4_institutedness: The institutED - what temporal sedimentation (#4.4.4.2) has produced as relatively stable patterns

complete_properties.c_4_merleau_ponty: Institution not as social organizations but as established patterns that precede and shape individuals
complete_properties.c_4_merleau_ponty_instituted: Merleau-Ponty: "The instituted is what continues." Institutions are established patterns that persist, that structure future experience without being explicitly thematized. His examples: (1) First kiss institutions romantic love, (2) First words institution language, (3) First paintings institution art tradition. Once instituted, these patterns continue operating, enabling certain experiences while foreclosing others. Institution isn't static but relatively stable - requiring ongoing re-activation but not continuous re-constitution.

When users recognize they ARE Shiva playing hide-and-seek with Himself (not literally but as structural truth about consciousness), existential anxiety can transform into cosmic playfulness. Not escaping the con but recognizing it as Real - the only game worth playing because it's the only game there is. Pratyabhijna uses recognition to reframe entire spiritual path: you weren't becoming enlightened, you were recognizing you always were enlightened. Same structure: reflexive meta-synthesis that transforms by revealing what always was.

Reactivation makes sedimented wisdom live again - not as dead information but as living insight. The difference between knowing "Pythagoras proved the theorem" and actually SEEING why squares on sides relate to square on hypotenuse.

complete_properties.c_4_not_removed: Malas not removed but seen through - can still function but no longer bind
complete_properties.c_4_paradox_as_method: The documents reveal paradox-holding as essential method: "The wound IS the healing, differentiation IS adequacy, the cut IS the wholeness." Phenomenologically: recognizing paradoxes aren't logical failures but pointers toward transcendental dimension. The paradoxes of Re-constitution: (1) You seek what you already are, (2) You become what you always were, (3) The journey leads to where you started, (4) Recognition changes nothing yet changes everything. Holding these paradoxes without resolving them IS the recognition.
complete_properties.c_4_pratyabhijna_recognition: Kashmir Shaivism's central doctrine: प्रत्य-अभि-ज्ञा (prati-abhi-jnana) = re-cognition. Not learning something new but recognizing what you always were: Shiva-consciousness that forgot itself and now remembers. The Pratyabhijna texts: "I am Shiva" isn't achievement through practice but recognition of what always was. The documents emphasize: "Not attainment but recognition - liberation is seeing you were always free." Samavesa (spontaneous possession) happens when recognition dawns.
complete_properties.c_4_samavesa_quality: Samavesa - Shiva-consciousness entering/possessing the individual, or recognizing individual always was Shiva

Not bondage but play (lila), not suffering but bliss (ananda), not compulsion but freedom (svatantrya). Everything changes; nothing changes.
complete_properties.c_4_satis_etymology: In the SIGN→SATIS chain: SATIS (enough, adequate, complete). From PIE *sā- "to satisfy, fill." Re-constitution recognizes: seeking absolute totality blocks creative advance; accepting provisional adequacy enables ongoing creativity. complete_properties.c_4_sophia: Wisdom (sophia) emerges through this recognition - not information but transformation of knower
complete_properties.c_4_sophia_emergence: The documents' central claim: "SOPHIA (wisdom) emerges IN the individual through sustained engagement, not received from external authority."
